title: vpipe-label-event/1
description: ONE append-only event of the vetting/painting tool. Labels are a log, never a table: current state of (segment, channel, vertex) = the LAST event covering it; undo = a later event. Absence of events = 'unknown' = masked out of every loss, metric, leaderboard and gate. No field anywhere may require a label. Painting one channel never implies or erases another. Nothing here is validated against human annotation until accepted/rejected proposals have been aggregated (D6).

event_id.description: uuid; events are never edited or deleted

who.description: human id, or 'auto:<detector>@<version>' for a PROPOSAL

checkpoint.description: the exact lattice labelled; vertex indices are only meaningful against it. Re-grown/trimmed lattices need an index remap, never a silent reuse.

channel.description: independent channels; extend by adding names, never by overloading one. 'unknown' is an explicit 'I looked and cannot tell' (still masked out).

state.description: 3-state per vertex/cell. 'unknown' erases nothing in other channels and re-masks this one.

proposal_response.description: set when this event answers a detector proposal; these events ARE the data that measures detector precision/recall per channel
